question.problem:
Which numbered angle refers to the same angle as $\widehat{GHA}?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14131632/assets/47841a386b57f8615897cb73b1b98f15e975c78722f29d8baca92e7c7663a527.png)
question.worked_solution:
If we trace along the letters of the angle name, from $G$ to $H$ to $A$,  we see that $\widehat{GHA}$ refers to the angle $\angle 3.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14131632/assets/100349e33233f2152ce236be2d17dc2fe3a59035a88336e26554eb6864d6059a.png)

Therefore, $\angle{3}$ is another name for $\widehat{GHA}.$
